market_summary: Late New York session trading shows low volatility and broad consolidation across all six covered markets following earlier directional extensions. Precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), EURUSD, and BTCUSD remain suppressed below session VWAP and Value Area Highs on sub-1.0 RVOL, while US100 is pinned between its Put Wall #1 (28300) and Gamma Flip (28318) in a negative amplifying regime without breakout flow. All setups lack high-volume confluence, dictating a disciplined HOLD across the entire portfolio.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3881.94, VAH 4000.33) and below POC 3978.13, hovering near VAL. CVD is -5.67 (BEARISH), showing negative order flow pressure despite a minor short-term bounce slope. Market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains well below downward-sloping session VWAP (3929.02) and structural EMA50 (3907.52). ATR band position is mid-channel between EMA20 (3883.84) and lower ATR band (3866.26). RVOL is 0.77 without yellow spike confirmation. Price is holding above Session Low support at 3852.35. GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with price above Gamma Flip (3868.14) and capped overhead by Call Wall #2 at 3887.14, favoring mean-reversion dampening rather than trend continuation.

Price is below VAL (1.10628) and below POC (1.10942). CVD is -3,902 (NEUTRAL) with positive short-term delta slope (+2,268.02) reflecting fading sell momentum. Market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below descending VWAP (1.10761) and below structural EMA50 (1.10703). ATR position is mid-to-lower channel towards lower band 1.10454. RVOL is subdued at 0.691 with no yellow volume spike to validate a fresh impulse. Price is consolidating narrowly above Session Low support at 1.10457. GEX is null.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32210, VAH 1.32665) and currently stalling right on POC (1.32300). CVD is -1,390 (NEUTRAL) with positive delta slope (+4,864.49) off the session base. Market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below descending VWAP (1.32519) and beneath EMA50 (1.32482), testing the EMA20 baseline (1.32362). ATR bands show mid-channel containment between 1.32212 and 1.32512. RVOL is 0.752 following a prior yellow spike bounce 2 bars ago off support. Price is respecting the triple-touch Session Low / VAL support at 1.32210, but fair-value compression around POC warrants patience. GEX is null.

Signal bar closed inside Value Area (POC 28122.95, VAH 28282.66, VAL 28027.12) above POC, while live price tests VAH at 28291.64. CVD is +1.47 (NEUTRAL) with a flat slope (+0.18). Market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains above session VWAP (28191.12) and above EMA50 (28252.97), but remains capped under EMA20 (28320.18). ATR position is mid-channel (28140.77 to 28499.59). RVOL is 0.748; per the US100 index CFD tick volume caveat, absence of yellow bars is common, but conviction is lacking. S/R support at 28265.71 held after a wick sweep. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (28318.24) with price pinned directly into Put Wall #1 at 28300.68, where selling into dealer support or buying directly under Gamma Flip offers unfavorable edge.

Price is below VAL (50.451) and well below POC (51.460). CVD is -262.96 (BEARISH), aligning with the intraday downward bias but showing minor flattening slope (+10.48). Market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades beneath falling VWAP (50.974) and below EMA50 (50.517) and EMA20 (50.168). ATR envelope shows mid-to-lower band compression (lower band 49.804). RVOL is 0.66 with no yellow spike breakout volume. Price is hovering above Session Low support at 49.688 with distant overhead resistance at S/R 50.711. GEX is null.

Price is below VAL (71798.38) and far below POC (73501.60). CVD is -0.07 (BEARISH), confirming the persistent intraday downward drift. Market session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trading below downward-sloping VWAP (72707.13), EMA50 (72307.15), and EMA20 (71789.75). ATR band position is mid-lower channel above lower band 71174.98. RVOL is low at 0.528 without volume expansion. Price bounced moderately from triple-touch Session Low support at 71141.0 but lacks momentum to challenge VAL. GEX is null.
